records.review_notes: The SEC-filed release announces a definitive agreement for MorphoSys to purchase Nasdaq CNST at $34 cash per share. Transaction Details specifies a tender for every outstanding common share followed by a merger for untendered shares. Royalty Pharma is a financing partner, not the target acquirer. Source-reviewed by Codex; not independently adjudicated by a human. Date is the sourced definitive-announcement calendar date; intraday publication time and exhaustive earliest-publication search were not established. Status is pending as described at announcement, not a present-day deal-status claim. Control percent means proposed post-transaction ownership, not acceptance threshold or the incremental stake purchased. Announcement evidence is a label only, never a pre-event feature.
records.review_scope: Definitive whole-company acquisition public announcement, jointly checked against complete disclosed merger chronology. Date-only precision retained; no exhaustive independent first-news search.
records.source_title: MorphoSys to Acquire Constellation Pharmaceuticals and Enter into Strategic Funding Partnership with Royalty Pharma
